title: The Naked and the Dead
author: Norman Mailer
current_text: The Naked and the Dead had been banned in Canada because its author had depicted sex or used profane words; the ban was reported in 1949. The Naked and the Dead was banned in Australia, ostensibly for its language.

sources.quote: In 1949, in Maclean’s magazine, Blair Fraser revealed the names of some of the banned books: William Faulkner’s Sanctuary, Norman Mailer’s The Naked and the Dead and Radclyffe Hall’s Well of Loneliness. These literary works had been banned because the authors had depicted sex or had used profane words.
Interestingly, while The Naked and the Dead did not get banned in England, it was indeed banned in Canada and Australia.
